hero.title: Dependable electrical manpower, when you need it.
hero.lead: NC Falcon connects contractors with skilled, evaluated electricians across North and South Carolina, and gives our electricians steady work. We respond within 24 hours.

why.title: Built from real experience in the field
why.intro: With more than 20 years of electrical experience behind us, we know what a jobsite actually needs. We solve manpower challenges fast.

cards.title: Fast Response
cards.text: Every inquiry gets a response within 24 hours.

cards.title: Direct to Leadership
cards.text: You talk to the people who own the business.

cards.title: Evaluated Workers
cards.text: Our electricians' experience is evaluated before placement and matched to your project's skill requirements.

cards.title: Flexible Staffing
cards.text: One helper or a full crew, short-term or long-term. We scale to your project and your schedule.

cards.title: NC & SC Coverage
cards.text: Based in Charlotte, serving the Carolinas. Open to opportunities nationwide, with per diem where it fits.

cards.title: Competitive Pricing
cards.text: Fair rates that keep your project on budget and keep skilled electricians earning a living wage.

staffing.title: Every skill level your job calls for
staffing.lead: From helpers to foremen, we recruit through referrals, industry connections, and word of mouth, then match the right person to your project.

positions.name: Helpers
positions.description: reliable hands to keep the crew moving

positions.name: Foremen
positions.description: run the crew and keep you on schedule

cta.title: Whichever side you're on, we're ready
cta.contractor_text: Tell us what you need and we'll get the right people on site.
cta.electrician_text: Apply online, upload your resume, and we'll be in touch.
